name: RemoteCount
description: RemoteCount is a newly introduced benchmark dataset for evaluating object counting ability in remote sensing images. It is part of the RemoteCLIP vision-language foundation model evaluation suite, which assesses zero-shot classification, linear probing, k-NN classification, few-shot classification, image-text retrieval, and object counting tasks in remote sensing.
reputation: A specialized remote-sensing benchmark used within the RemoteCLIP evaluation suite, with limited but growing adoption for counting-focused vision-language evaluation.
notes: RemoteCount is introduced as part of RemoteCLIP evaluation; RemoteCLIP leverages large-scale data scaling and UAV imagery for pretraining.
